title: Any risk the framework cannot quantify is capitalized at 100%, making unmeasured risk maximally expensive rather than free
content:
A.3.2.1.1.3.2 is one line with outsized consequences: "If Instance Financial RRC, Instance Smart Contract RRC, or Instance Administrative RRC for an Instance cannot be calculated then the Instance Total CRR is 100%."

A 100% CRR means the Agent must hold risk capital equal to the entire invested amount — economically identical to being unable to use Sky's capital at all. Unquantifiable risk is therefore not permitted-by-default nor forbidden-by-rule; it is priced at the maximum, which makes the prohibition self-enforcing and removes any need for a gatekeeper to say no.

The pattern recurs at finer granularity. A.3.2.2.1.1.1.1.4 defines an Unauthorized Exposure as an underlying asset of a lending market that was not in the pro-forma RRC estimate approved by the Core Council Risk Advisor, and reasons: "Because the risk of an Unauthorized Exposure has not been assessed, its Capital Ratio Requirement is 100%, applying at the exposure level the full-reservation principle." A.3.2.2.1.1.1.1.3.8.1 shows it applied in practice inside an otherwise 1–4% Morpho vault, where the mF-One / USDC market carries CRR = 100%.

The important refinement is that the charge is proportionate, not punitive: "An Instance's Capital Ratio Requirement is the capital-weighted aggregate of its exposures' Capital Ratio Requirements, so an Instance with only a fraction of its capital in Unauthorized Exposures has a Capital Ratio Requirement below 100%." A lending market that quietly adds a new collateral asset therefore raises the Agent's capital requirement smoothly in proportion to drift, instead of instantly invalidating the whole position — a graduated failure mode for a risk that arises from someone else's governance decisions.
description: If any RRC component for an Instance cannot be calculated its Total CRR is 100%; the same full-reservation rule applies to Unauthorized Exposures, weighted by their share of Instance capital.
